short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: How long until the capacitor is full?
short_scenes.narration: Volt wonders how long a capacitor takes to charge.
Watch the curve. After one time constant, sixty three percent. After five, practically full.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: A capacitor charges quickly when empty, then slower and slower as it fills, like filling a bottle under a tap that gets weaker. The time constant R C sets the speed.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: One kilo-ohm times one thousand microfarads is one second. Done after five seconds.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: For the detailed explanation, watch the full video on our channel. It's part of our complete Network Theory course.
